label: Metastatic HER2+ with treated brain metastases, progressed on T-DXd
summary: 63-year-old woman with metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer (HER2 IHC 3+, ER 10%, PR 0%). Diagnosed de novo metastatic in 2023 with liver and bone metastases. First-line docetaxel + trastuzumab + pertuzumab (2023-2024), then maintenance trastuzumab + pertuzumab. In August 2025 developed 3 brain metastases treated with stereotactic radiosurgery; brain stable on most recent MRI (September 2026), off steroids. Second-line trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) from September 2025, with progression in the liver in October 2026. No history of interstitial lung disease. LVEF 58% on echo in July 2026. ECOG 1. Labs: normal blood counts, bilirubin normal, creatinine normal.
